recipe.build:
sed -r '/signingConfigs.getByName/d ; /create\("release"\) \{/,/^        \}/d' -i android/app/build.gradle.kts
export PUB_CACHE=$(pwd)/.pub-cache
base64 -d > .env <<< 
submodules/flutter/bin/flutter pub run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs
submodules/flutter/bin/flutter build apk --split-per-abi --target-platform="android-arm64"
find . -name '*.apk'
mv build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-arm64-v8a-release.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk
